intent: Let the new ~/home_inventory Flutter app get an on-style family launcher icon, and let it survive the phone focus daemon so it can be installed and used on BL9000EEA0000102.
scope: Non-goal: no change to the icon family's shared accent, canvas, stroke or safe-box constants
Non-goal: no change to any existing app's glyph
changes: Added _STORAGE_BOX: an isometric carton drawn as a regular hexagon (centre 512,512, circumradius 240) plus the three edges meeting at the near-top corner. Opposite faces sit 208px apart, leaving 136px hollow after the 72px stroke, so no face fills in at 48dp; rendered ink is 488x552, inside SAFE_BOX on both axes.

A first attempt drew a front-on rectangle with a lid seam and a tape line. Rejected after rendering the contact sheet: a seam plus a divider reads as a browser window or a table header, not a box. The isometric form collides with nothing else in the family.
Registered app_icons entry key='home_inventory', glyph='storage-box', icon_name='home-inventory', accent='#B8862E' (the one shared family accent — not a per-app colour), linux=False.
Added com.kuhy.home_inventory to the '--- User-requested productive apps ---' block of the focus-mode WHITELIST, beside the other com.kuhy.* apps.

verification.evidence: All hooks Passed (ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit, pytest-with-coverage, shellcheck, codespell, binary block, secret scan); three hooks Skipped for having no matching files.

43 passed. Every app_icons module at 100%: apps.py 24/24, glyphs.py 23/23, cli.py 60/60, generate.py 41/41, preview.py 41/41, render.py 48/48, style.py 11/11. The registry invariant tests iterate APPS/GLYPHS, so the new entries are covered by construction.

Wrote 6 asset files to ~/home_inventory/assets/icon and regenerated the Android mipmaps, with no safe-box warning. An earlier 500px-wide variant emitted 'glyph exceeds the 560px safe box by 12x0px' because STROKE_WIDTH adds 72px to each rendered dimension; the body was narrowed to 488px.
Contact sheet read directly. The glyph reads as a 3D package at full size, circle-masked and 48dp, and is distinct from cloud-down, barbell, clock, shield-cutlery, checklist and chain-link.

Returned 1 after pushing config.sh and running 'focus_ctl.sh restart' (Daemon stopped PID 6504, started PID 25811). The release APK then installed, launched and stayed running rather than being pm disable-user'd ~1s after launch.

risks: The whitelist was pushed to the phone with the targeted three-command adb path rather than phone_focus_mode/deploy.sh, so the Magisk hosts module was deliberately not touched. If a future full deploy.sh run overwrites /data/local/tmp/focus_mode/config.sh from the repo, this entry is already committed here and survives.
app_icons/cli.py derives --app choices from sorted(apps.APPS), so anyone on an older checkout cannot regenerate this app's icon until they pull.
The glyph is tuned to the current STROKE_WIDTH of 72 and SAFE_BOX of 560; changing either would need the 488x440 body re-checked against the safe box.
rollback: Revert this commit. The icon assets already written into ~/home_inventory/assets/icon and its android mipmaps live in that repo, so delete them there separately if the app is abandoned.

After rollback, re-run 'python3 -m pytest python_pkg/app_icons' to confirm the registry invariants still hold, and re-push phone_focus_mode/config.sh to the phone so its whitelist matches the repo again — otherwise the phone keeps whitelisting a package the repo no longer lists.
